title: Determination of the length of single-walled carbon nanotubes by scanning electron microscopy
author: Sandoval, Kierkowicz, et al.

steps.title: Disperse CNTs in ODCB
steps.instruction: Add a tiny amount of single‑walled carbon nanotubes to 3 mL ortho‑dichlorobenzene in a vial and sonicate for at least 30 min until a homogeneous pale‑grey suspension is obtained.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate ≥30 min until suspension is homogeneous pale‑grey

steps.title: Drop‑cast onto carbon‑coated grid
steps.instruction: Place a drop of the dispersion onto a copper TEM grid coated with a continuous carbon film and let it dry completely.

steps.title: Acquire SEM images
steps.instruction: Insert the dried grid into the SEM, set the microscope to secondary‑electron (SE) mode, use a transmission‑line detector (TLD), and acquire micrographs at 2 kV to obtain surface‑sensitive high‑contrast images of individual SWCNTs.
